title: Critique: a mechanistic explanation may still come

statements.text: The absence of a mechanistic explanation of consciousness today does not show one is out of reach. Life once seemed to need a vital force and was explained, and a Darwin of consciousness may yet do the same for experience.

sources.quote: Perhaps we just need the 'Darwin of consciousness' to come along and do something similar in the mental realm.
Today, however, no one seriously doubts that life emerged from matter that involved no life at all.
